charter.purpose: Help developers change the made-up Harbour Loans demo application safely.
in_scope: Python Plotly Dash pages and callbacks for the Harbour Loans demo
architecture_principles: All database access goes through db_table_functions.
constraints: Python 3.14 only, with pinned library versions.

glossary.meaning: One developer change, tracked from start to handoff.

rules.title: Error messages are plain sentences
rules.why: Developers must understand what went wrong without reading a stack trace.
rules.good_example: raise ConfigError("DA_DB_PATH is empty. Set it in your .env file.")

rules.title: Use Dash Mantine Components for form controls
rules.why: One component set keeps every page looking and behaving the same.

never_generate_zones.name: Security
never_generate_zones.description: Encryption, key handling, and permission checks are written by people only.

never_generate_zones.name: Login
never_generate_zones.description: Sign-in, sessions, and passwords are written by people only.
